title: PAF agents/<key>/context/losses.json
description: Counts and categories only; never transcript content.

source.description: The harness the conversation was decoded from.

target.description: The harness the conversation was written for, when the report describes a translation or landing.

dropped_percent.description: Share of source entries left out, rounded up; with kept_percent it sums to 100.

fallback.description: Legacy morph delivery name. Known: native (meaning translated into a native conversation), context_file, handoff.

kind.description: Open set; readers accept unknown kinds.

severity.description: Open set; readers accept unknown values. Known: info, warn.

prior.description: Reports of earlier translations of the same conversation, oldest first. Each has the fields of losses.json, without its own prior.

landing_rung.description: Open set. Known: native, translated, context_file, archive.
